title: Introduce lightweight RAG CLI snapshotter and live contract sync
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a lightweight RAG developer loop quickstart: a CLI snapshotter that captures index+corpus state, a background contract sync daemon that mirrors authored tool contracts into the docs playground, and a compact tutorial for live-iterative authoring. Motivation: reduce friction when iterating retrieval+tooling locally and to make authoring-contract mismatches visible early. This PR contains: 1) new quickstart docs and tutorial (docs/rag/devloop-snapshotter.md and guided examples), 2) a minimal CLI binary (cmd/rag-snap) used to record and replay index snapshots, 3) a small dev daemon (pkg/syncer) that watches tool-contract files and updates live contract playground JSON used by examples, 4) updated examples and devcontainer for reproducible local runs. Checklist: - [x] Quickstart guide written - [x] CLI implementation with basic record/replay - [x] Contract syncer with in-memory mock server - [x] Devcontainer + sample corpus - [x] Unit tests for snapshot/restore - [x] E2E smoke validated on CI
